text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock D and Stock E below my average cost; before selling, I should reassess their prospects and use a consistent rule rather than react to losses.","I bought more Stock A after it had risen sharply, so I should avoid chasing recent gains and check that a purchase still fits my plan and risk limits.","Buying Stock E after a decline did not by itself make it a bargain; I should base additions on a clear thesis, keep cash and diversification in mind, and stay focused on my apartment goal."]}
